resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second line-and-color direction is the measured axis. Render its named contours, jewel palette, value planes, and rim accent across one continuous figure. Create a clean hand-drawn two-dimensional editorial illustration. The exact name-free signature controls the visible medium, face, eyes, silhouette, palette, light, composition, and ornament. Make these eight cues bold and unmistakable: line language—flowing pressure-sensitive ribbon contours; face design—a firm jaw and planar cheeks; eye design—narrow dark-rimmed eyes with one catchlight; body design—elongated graceful limbs and tapered hands; palette language—large mineral-blue, ivory, coral, and charcoal fields; light modeling—broad visible painterly light and shadow masses; framing language—a centered figure inside an emblem-like border; ornament language—repeated textile bands and woven motifs. Draw face and eye details crisply within the full-length figure. Put the ornament on both the garment and outer border. Keep the complete figure in front of every decorative framing element. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult subject is defined by rounded soft contours with smooth turns and gently reinforced focal features, filled with warm earth color built from clay, sand, olive, cream, and softened brown, and modeled through subtle contact shadows with open midtones and carefully preserved reflected light. The finish adds a controlled rim accent that separates only the shadow-side silhouette. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—frame literally from the complete crown through both feet, with generous visible background margin above the hairstyle and below both shoes.
